objects.name: Export & Email Excel to Supply Chain Director
objects.description: Because the Supply Chain Director (Arjun Mehta) doesn't use Power BI Service, export the main table as Excel and email it directly to him (CC warehouse managers) after publishing.

objects.name: Power BI Desktop October 2024+ Requirement
objects.description: A connector change in this version is required for the Revenue dashboard to refresh correctly; older versions break it.

objects.name: SharePoint (Finance Site)
objects.description: Hosts all three .pbix files (PBI Reports folder), the Revenue raw extract drop folder, and the Item_Master.xlsx costing file; also provides version history for recovery.

objects.name: Data Source Credentials Error
objects.description: Appears when a refresh's underlying Excel/CSV file path has changed or the file isn't in the expected folder.

objects.name: Expression Error: Column Not Found (Revenue)
objects.description: Occurs when the Region Lookup table gains a new column or a SAP-extract column is renamed; fixed manually in Power Query's Transform Data step. No written guide exists for this fix.

objects.name: Inventory TXT Encoding Issue
objects.description: Occasionally the pipe-delimited file is ANSI instead of UTF-8, producing garbled characters; must be re-saved as UTF-8 in Notepad.

objects.name: Scheduled Maintenance Windows
objects.description: Avoid refreshing during the Power BI Service window (Sunday 2-4 AM IST) or SAP's monthly maintenance window (last Saturday, ~10 PM-2 AM), which can affect Inventory data availability.

objects.name: No Formal Backup Schedule
objects.description: Recovery relies entirely on SharePoint's built-in version history; there is no formal, scheduled backup process for any of the three dashboards.

objects.name: No Central SOP or Documentation Exists
objects.description: Explicitly confirmed by the outgoing owner: 'There's nothing written down. This has all been in my head.' No consolidated SOP exists for any of the three dashboards prior to this KT session.

objects.name: Single-Person Institutional Knowledge
objects.description: Refresh procedures, contacts, validation heuristics, and error fixes for all three dashboards existed only in the outgoing owner's head prior to this KT session.

note: DEV_MODE default mock — supply mock_response for deterministic test data.
